alejandra: heads up — onboarding sampleapp is flaking for a few customers. they hit a SchemaValidationError after the model function_call returns. We see model output parsed as an array instead of the expected object so our SDK helper throws 400s. paste of error:
```
SchemaValidationError: expected object at root, got array
  at validate (/opt/redwood/sdk/helpers/schema.js:142:12)
  at handleFnCall (/app/server/onboard.js:87:5)
  at process._tickCallback (internal/process/next_tick.js:68:7)
```
model raw content we logged: `[ ["create_ticket", {"title":"Login fails","priority":"high"}] ]`
This started after the recent token-refresh retry change. :thinking_face:

ryan: is this JSON mode or function_call?

alejandra: function_call with JSON mode enabled. We instruct model to return structured object. The sample app uses the SDK helper that validates shape.

samir: oh — I think I reproduced locally. If the auth token expires mid-request the SDK retries the call. The retried request sometimes receives a different chunking order from the model (we're streaming), and our streaming-assembler currently collapses top-level arrays into the final string which ends up double-wrapped. Repro steps I used:
1) set token TTL to 1s in dev env
2) force request to stream with small chunk size
3) trigger function_call
4) SDK retry happens and final assembled payload becomes `[[..., ...]]` instead of `[..., ...]`
I can send logs.

devex-bot: created issue #2428 (devex/sdk): "onboard sampleapp: array-wrapped function_call output when token refresh triggers retry" — assigned to @maya

maya: ack. quick thought — we should avoid changing the model response shape in the SDK if possible. Two immediate mitigations:
- sample app post-process: if validator fails and top-level type is array, try to coerce common shapes (eg [name, payload] -> {action: name, params: payload}) and log a telemetry event.
- SDK helper: make optional lenient mode that attempts a few canonical coercions before rejecting. This keeps onboarding smooth but still surfaces real model failures.

oliver: agreed on coercion heuristics in sample app. For parity — JS SDK currently has a permissive fallback that tries to parse arrays; Python SDK is stricter and fails early. We'll need to modify both so behavior matches. Also suggest adding a debug log containing the raw model tokens when we hit this path so we can share with model team.

ryan: on the retry/auth side — is this an SDK bug (reassembly) or an edge case because of streaming + retries? If the SDK replays the request we must ensure the assembly logic resets between attempts. Otherwise you can get nested arrays. That seems like an easy fix.

alejandra: customers are blocked from completing onboarding. can we do a quick hotfix in the sampleapp to coerce and then follow up with a proper SDK patch?

maya: I'll open a small PR for sampleapp that adds a fallback coercion plus a feature-flag around lenient parsing. Tests included. Plan: merge to staging today, patch prod sampleapp tomorrow if no regressions. I'll also add an integration test that simulates token expiry + retry.

samir: i'll create a unit test that simulates streaming chunk reassembly across retries and assert the buffer is reset. will file separate PR to SDK.

ryan: we should also update the SDK changelog and call out parity breaks so downstream users know the change. Add a migration note for those who relied on strict validation.

alejandra: thanks. can someone ping eng-ml to check if model prompts are accidentally producing array-first outputs? maybe a model behavior change combined with our retry bug amplified it.

maya: will loop in @eng-ml and @observability. tagging issue #2428. I'll include the telemetry event name `onboard.fncall.coercion` and sample logs.

devex-bot: labels: [bug, onboarding, sdk]. milestone: v0.9.3.

alejandra: awesome — appreciate the quick turnaround. leaving notes for support to escalate affected customers to a workaround (disable strict validation in their sampleapp). :thumbsup:
